title: 4.9 Unit 4 Review
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Review Unit 4 through fresh scenes: rooms, furniture, where things are, there is and there are, the morning routine and daily actions, and days and time. No new language.
grammar_function: This is the + room; there is / there are; in, on, under, next to; Where is...?; I + daily action; first, then, every day; in the morning / afternoon, at night; on + day; It is ... o'clock.
speaking_outcome: Say six Unit 4 lines aloud across rooms, object location, existence, routine and time.
